title: AI-translated pages say so to readers and agents
description:
As a reader or an agent, I want every translated page to say it was translated by AI from a linked original and whether a person reviewed it, so I know what I am reading.

Readers: a plain line under the byline in the page's language, linking the original. Agents: JSON-LD inLanguage, translationOfWork and translator; Markdown twin front matter language, translatedFrom, translation: machine, reviewed; llms.txt and the agent guide explain it. Translated quotations are marked and show the original wording. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450).

Feature: Translation labels

Scenario: A reader sees the label
  Given a published Spanish localization reviewed by a person
  When a reader opens it
  Then a line under the byline says it was translated by AI from the English original and reviewed, with a link to the original

Scenario: An agent reads the label
  Given the same page
  When an agent requests its Markdown twin
  Then the front matter names the language, the original URL, machine translation and reviewed true

Scenario: A translated quotation shows its original
  Given an English quotation in the original
  When the Spanish page renders it
  Then it is marked as translated and the original wording is available beside it
